subject: Launch: EU cross-border MAP & evaluation timeline for SimpliBank
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@simplibank.eu>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 08:42:00 +0000
Subject: Launch: EU cross-border MAP & evaluation timeline for SimpliBank

Marta —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, I’m kicking off a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align the evaluation activities we need to complete before procurement and legal can sign off. High level goals:

- Capture the evaluation scope (latency, residency, audit trail)
- Assign internal/external owners for each workstream
- Agree on a target close date so we can commit resources

Proposed next steps (suggested owners in parentheses):
1) Data residency & cross-border review — deep dive with your privacy team (SimpliBank: Marta/Tomasz; Redwood: Laura)
2) Security evidence & gap list — provide SOC2 artifacts, encryption details (Redwood: Laura)
3) Eval plan & perf window — 2-week test window with production-like traffic (Redwood: Vanessa / SimpliBank: Ops lead)
4) Commercial & legal checkpoints — outline contract timeline (SimpliBank: Procurement; Redwood: me + Vanessa)

Target close: 2027-01-28 (this is flexible — want to validate with your procurement timeline). I attached a lightweight MAP template to iterate on.

Attachments: SimpliBank_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP template)

Would you and Tomasz be able to confirm primary owners and availability for a 30-min stakeholder kickoff next week?

Thanks,
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Marta Novak <marta.novak@simplibank.eu>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tomasz Kowalczyk <t.kowalczyk@simplibank.eu>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, SimpliBank Procurement <procurement@simplibank.eu>
Date: Fri, 18 Dec 2026 12:05:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Launch: EU cross-border MAP & evaluation timeline for SimpliBank

Hi Karthik —

Thanks for pulling this together. Tomasz and I reviewed the outline and it looks good. Quick confirmations from our side:

- Primary owners: Privacy (Tomasz), Security evidence (me), Ops/test coordination (Ana Petrovic — I’ll copy separately once she’s back from leave)
- Procurement target: internal approval by 2027-02-07 if MAP completes by 2027-01-28
- Must cover cross-border replication for backups to the UK and Norway — that’s a hard requirement from legal

A couple of asks before kickoff:
- Can Redwood confirm encryption-at-rest details and key management flow (KMS/HSM) in advance?
- Please add a short performance acceptance criteria section to the MAP: 95th pct latency target and allowed error rates for streaming endpoints.

I can do a 30-min kickoff on Mon 2026-12-21 at 09:30 CET. Does that work?

Best,
Marta

--
Marta Novak
Head of Cloud Privacy, SimpliBank
marta.novak@simplibank.eu
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marta Novak <marta.novak@simplibank.eu>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Dec 2026 07:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Launch: EU cross-border MAP & evaluation timeline for SimpliBank

Marta / Tomasz / Karthik —

Following up ahead of today’s kickoff: I uploaded a short SOC2 evidence overview and a one-page KMS diagram — see attached. Quick notes from security: 

- Encryption at rest: AES-256 with customer-managed keys available via KMS/HSM integration (we can run a key-wrapping demo during the eval)
- Cross-border backups: snapshot replication can be constrained by region tag; we’ll include an ops runbook for restricting backup targets
- Audit logs: per-tenant audit retention is configurable; default retention is 90 days but we can extend per contract

I added a first pass at the ‘perf acceptance’ section in the MAP worksheet and flagged two tasks for Redwood owners. Please review so we can lock the MAP during the call.

Attachments: SOC2-evidence-overview.pdf

On the call at 09:30 CET I’ll cover: security checklist, KMS flow, and evidence handoff timing (10 min). Vanessa will run through the eval schedule and support model.

Thanks,
Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Director, Trust & Security, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marta Novak <marta.novak@simplibank.eu>
Date: Tue, 20 Dec 2026 15:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Launch: EU cross-border MAP & evaluation timeline for SimpliBank

Quick internal note (threading my update to the kickoff):

- Kickoff confirmed for Mon 2026-12-21 09:30 CET (calendar invite sent)
- Eval plan: 2-week window starting 2027-01-09, Redwood to provide test harness and sample traffic generator
- Commercial milestone plan: initial SOW draft by 2027-01-10; procurement tick on 2027-02-07 if MAP passes
- Action items assigned: 
  * Laura — deliver SOC2 artifacts and KMS diagram (due 2026-12-21 call)
  * Karthik — coordinate procurement timeline and final MAP worksheet (due 2027-01-05)
  * Vanessa — run perf acceptance criteria and test harness (due 2027-01-08)

I’ll follow up post-call with an updated MAP file and HubSpot record.

Vanessa

--
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
